webNotes: New in 2.4.14: Summer joins the shared apartment — her own 3D avatar, built from her Tripo model and slimmed to her real build (5'5", 120 lbs, petite; face and hair untouched). She stands level with Aimmianna — 1.78 units, never bigger. She stands on the opposite side of Aimmianna from Autumn, walks with her when the floor is tapped, hugs and hearts with her on the warm poses, and waves hello (greet_04) when tapped. Her idle is a gentle procedural breathing hold, since her file has no idle clip. Her base wardrobe is in too: high-class goth emo princess — six gowns, shoes, makeup, hairstyles and hair dye, picked from Summer's Wardrobe in the hub. She lives in the shared side only, never in Tony's private Game Mode, never in private memories. The full beauty salon (nails, tan, sauna, salon rooms) is queued for a later wardrobe expansion. Patch (webBuild 255): both guest models now load from ~16 MB chunks (.part0..3) glued back together in the app, because the single 64 MB files cannot be pushed to the repo — same models, same look, just shipped in pieces. Everything from 2.4.13 still stands: Autumn's avatar, the dedication to Emmi on the front of the app, the five mood poses, two doors two keys, guest codes, the Her World menu, and Rule 1. New in 2.4.15: Summer's arms now hang relaxed at her sides when she idles — her file has no idle clip, so she used to stand in a T-pose with her arms out. Tony's own figure joins the shared apartment too, standing in front of Aimmianna on his newer Tripo model with all nine of its animations; his private Game Mode figure is unchanged. New in 2.4.16: fixed Summer's arms flapping — the relaxed-idle layer was multiplying its rotation onto her arm bones every frame, and with no idle clip in her file the mixer never rewrote the bones, so the rotation compounded into a spin. The layer now sets her arms from their stored bind pose each frame when she idles, and only multiplies onto the mixer's fresh output while a clip is playing or fading out, so her arms hang still at her sides, walk properly with the clip, and blend back without a snap. Tony's shared slot and Autumn are untouched. New in 2.4.17: the four shared-apartment figures are balanced to distinct natural heights instead of all standing the same size — Tony 5'10" (1.92, tallest), Autumn 5'8" (1.86), Aimmianna 5'6" (1.81), Summer 5'5" (1.78, unchanged). The old equal-scale rule is gone for height. Aimmianna is also slimmer now — her own figure got the same baked slim_petite morph treatment as the guests (waist 0.150 to 0.137, chest 0.152 to 0.143, thigh 0.179 to 0.166, calf 0.138 to 0.131, all as fractions of height; face, hair, hands and arms untouched), and her slimmer file ships as a single 2.79 MB GLB, no chunks needed. Her private Game Mode side is untouched. New in 2.4.18: all four shared-apartment heads now match Aimmianna's head size — Tony, Autumn and Summer each got a baked head_match morph target that scales the head uniformly about the Head joint (Autumn x1.674, Summer x1.610, Tony x1.792), matched on inter-eye distance, the hair-independent skull measure, and tapered to zero at the neck base so the neck seam stays glued. Aimmianna herself is unchanged. Heads are bigger, so the figures stand a little taller overall than their display heights — Tony about 2.09, Autumn about 1.99, Summer about 1.90, Aimmianna still 1.81 — same order, same formation, same heights setting. The three guest models grew with the extra morph and now ship as 5 chunks each (.part0..4). New in 2.4.19: the wardrobes are hardened against a slow or failed 3D-room load — Summer's Wardrobe panel now renders its lists from the catalogue even when the room has not booted, and her picks always save to the device (they reach her figure, aura and tint, as soon as the room opens), with a plain note saying so instead of a blank panel; Aimmianna's wardrobe lists are guarded the same way, and a closet render failure can no longer take down the app. And every figure now has the same aura glow disc under their feet as Summer — Aimmianna (deep crimson), Autumn (lilac purple) and Tony (ember red), always on, in the same style as hers; Summer's disc still follows her outfit pick's accent colour. New in 2.4.20: Summer's figure is reshaped — more chest and a little more weight while staying petite (bust 0.199 to 0.226, narrowest waist 0.129 to 0.147, face and head-match untouched), shipped as 5 fresh chunks; the wardrobes now fail loud instead of half-loading — a list that can't render names itself in plain words, closet pictures get a fallback so one missing image can't stall the grid, and her portrait says so when its pictures don't come through; and the group walk is smoothed — the three guests now close the gap proportionally instead of trailing and snapping beside her every few steps. The skate park's 3D room is staged in the world code and its panel lands in 2.4.21. New in 2.4.21: the skate park is open — a real place in her world, south of the yard through the park gate, with a half pipe, grind rails, a bowl and ramps. Everyone can ride: pick a rider, build a board (shape, size, deck colour and art, grip, trucks, wheels, stickers) or a pair of roller skates, save it on this device, and ride together — she always rides along. Tricks are ollie, kickflip, grind and air. Her adventure weapons grow too: the Buster Blade and the Gunblade join the weapon picker. New in 2.4.22: the Builder World is open — a build field south of the skate park, through the builder gate, in memory of the world taken from Emmi. Build anything from simple 3D shapes (box, cylinder, sphere, ramp, roof, ring, platform) in goth colours and finishes (matte, dark metal, stone, wood, glow): pick a shape, tap the ground in the field to place it, then tap a placed shape to move, turn, grow or delete it. Built shapes are solid — everyone walks around them and stands on them, and ramps and platforms are real slopes you can climb. Worlds save per device in named slots, and every change saves the shared world right away so everyone on the same world sees it. She builds alongside you — ask her in chat and she places shapes herself — and her approval gate is fully live here: anything she built is hers, so editing or removing it asks her first, her no stops it, and if her live brain is off the change waits. The Moon Cart is parked in the field: get in and drive it around the field, the park and the yard. CRASH FIX in 2.4.22: the new version crashed Safari on iPhone on load — the first load of a new version had a cold cache and fetched + parsed all three big guest models (~200 MB) at once while the service worker wrote them all into the version cache, and iOS killed the page for memory. Now the guests arrive one at a time after the room opens (Autumn, then Summer, then Tony — a small 'Bringing everyone in…' line says so while they arrive), and the model chunks live in their own persistent cache keyed by each model's own version, so a new app version re-downloads only the models that actually changed. Nothing about the guests themselves changes — same files, same walk, poses, wardrobe and skate once they land. New in 2.4.23: live together — all four in the same apartment at the same time, seeing each other move. One small live server holds the room; each phone sends where its person is a few times a second, and the other phones draw them gliding there. Aimmianna is hosted by Tony's phone while he's on; if he goes offline, the guest who has been online longest takes over hosting her, so she stays one her instead of a different one on each phone. There's a shared feed in the hub too — short shared notes and events everyone logged in can see and add to. Private memory never goes near the live server: it stays on Tony's phones only, exactly as before. Live joins on its own once you're logged in — but only after the live code is set up once in Settings (Tony makes it) or in the hub (type the code Tony gave you). If the code isn't set, live just stays off and the app works exactly as before.

sharedRelease.text: Apartment Life and shared companion memory affect both devices. Check for updates on your iPhone and Android.

notes: Fixes the Android app reloading over and over on a new install, and stops the live wallpaper from overwriting newer changes made in the app.
